statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-111760 is GitHub advisory GHSA-vp2w-7xxj-jvxr: https://github.com/git/git/security/advisories/GHSA-vp2w-7xxj-jvxr . A malicious repository can contain trees whose combined path lengths overflow the 32-bit name-length field of Git's cache entries, so checkout writes a path that passed validation under a different name and can overwrite .git, pointing Git at attacker-controlled configuration or hooks that then run code on the cloning user's system. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is in commit https://github.com/git/git/commit/29411cf59fd417d8fce1be40ab2911e3e0885f26 , which rejects cache entries whose names are too long before their length is truncated, together with the size_t length fixes in https://github.com/git/git/commit/df246839249110b852848db70501296d99bf1d7d and https://github.com/git/git/commit/fd48e6f35621ebd4657acb4a74d8638466a4dbbc . The 2.52.1-r0 build is Alpine's security upgrade to Git 2.52.1, which contains the fix: https://git.alpinelinux.org/aports/commit/?id=2f20de3527863b1b84f620fefe687921498e7240 . We checked every ELF program in the git package in both published builds, 2.52.0-r0 and 2.52.1-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64: in 2.52.1-r0 all six contain the fix's new error message "index entry path is too long (", and in 2.52.0-r0 none does. Earlier builds of this owner predate the fix.

CVE-2026-111760 is GitHub advisory GHSA-vp2w-7xxj-jvxr: https://github.com/git/git/security/advisories/GHSA-vp2w-7xxj-jvxr . A malicious repository can contain trees whose combined path lengths overflow the 32-bit name-length field of Git's cache entries, so checkout writes a path that passed validation under a different name and can overwrite .git, pointing Git at attacker-controlled configuration or hooks that then run code on the cloning user's system. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is in commit https://github.com/git/git/commit/29411cf59fd417d8fce1be40ab2911e3e0885f26 , which rejects cache entries whose names are too long before their length is truncated, together with the size_t length fixes in https://github.com/git/git/commit/df246839249110b852848db70501296d99bf1d7d and https://github.com/git/git/commit/fd48e6f35621ebd4657acb4a74d8638466a4dbbc . Debian's git 1:2.47.3-0+deb13u1 does not include it, and the Debian tracker lists trixie as vulnerable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-111760 . DHI backports the three commits, adapted to the Git 2.47 tree only where documentation file names and test build wiring differ. The fixed version is the first build that carries the backport, and its shipped changelog lists it. We checked every ELF program in the git package of the two builds in the DHI Debian repository, on amd64 and arm64: all 13 in the fixed build contain the fix's new error message "index entry path is too long (" and its index.maxpathlen setting, and none in the build before it does. In the -dbgsym symbol tables, make_empty_cache_entry also grows from 131 to 148 bytes on amd64 and from 124 to 144 bytes on arm64 between those two builds. Earlier builds of 2.47.3-0+deb13u1 also predate the backport.
